admission_checks: single owner long-run and reset acceptance
bound all setup/reset/forward/sense/graph/ledger calls before execution
failure: stop that new run, retain started and attempted counts; no automatic retry/scale-up/finer tiers

metrics.aggregate_sim_seconds_per_second: successful measured public transitions * 0.020 / measured wall seconds
metrics.env_transitions_per_second: successful measured public transitions / synchronized measured wall seconds
metrics.latency: public-step median/p95, include cross-process orchestration, sync before timing boundaries
metrics.memory: CUDA peak allocated/reserved, driver used/free, host RSS and number of contexts
metrics.native_integrations_per_second: measured completed native integrations / measured wall seconds; separate from transitions
metrics.numerics: accepted tier histogram, rejections, replay failures, failed API attempts; no tolerance changes
metrics.overhead: startup/JIT, warmup, measured stepping, durable WAL, artifact writing reported separately
metrics.per_env_realtime_factor: measured public steps per owner * 0.020 / measured wall seconds (equal step counts only)

scope: One short pilot at N=1 then N=2 only after backend release and a complete budget; not a stable throughput estimate
wall_clock: no invented runtime deadline; operation budget first; 5-second heartbeat is not timeout
